name: Tropical Circuit Weight Analysis (TCWA)

primitives.name: Tropical Circuit
primitives.description: A directed acyclic graph G with nodes labeled as inputs (variables or constants), tropical addition (min or max), or tropical multiplication (usual addition). Edge weights w: E → ℤ are integers. Computation proceeds by tropical semiring rules: min-plus or max-plus arithmetic. Can be implemented as a Python class with nodes, edges, and evaluation method over ℤ.

primitives.name: Tropical Derivation
primitives.description: A formal derivative operator on tropical circuits: for a node computing min(x,y), the derivation selects the active operand (argmin) with tie-breaking via lexicographic ordering. Implemented as a dynamic edge-selection map during evaluation on input vectors.

primitives.name: Weight Profile
primitives.description: For a tropical circuit C and input x ∈ ℤⁿ, the weight profile is the sequence of edge weights traversed during evaluation under tropical semantics, ordered by topological evaluation. Computable via trace during forward pass.

primitives.name: Circuit Phase Space
primitives.description: Partition of input space ℝⁿ into convex polyhedral regions where the tropical circuit's active computation path (i.e., argmin/argmax decisions) remains constant. Each phase cell is defined by linear inequalities; computable via tropical hypersurface decomposition.

operations.name: Phase Merging
operations.description: Given two phase spaces P₁, P₂ from circuits C₁, C₂, return the refinement of their Minkowski sum under superposition. Implemented via convex hull and hyperplane arrangement intersection.

operations.name: Tropical Linearization
operations.description: Compute the piecewise-linear derivation map δ_C(x) that outputs, for each input x, the active edge structure (a combinatorial gradient). Implemented via forward-mode tropical automatic differentiation.

operations.name: Weight Accumulation Trace
operations.description: Evaluate circuit on input x and return the weight profile (sequence of edge weights along active path). Used to define complexity measures based on arithmetic dynamics.

operations.name: Circuit Homotopy
operations.description: Deform edge weights continuously while preserving functional equivalence on integer inputs. Implemented via affine lifting of weights with tie-breaking preservation constraints.

operations.name: Duality Flip
operations.description: Transform min-plus circuit to max-plus (or vice versa) by negating all weights and inverting comparison logic. Preserves expressible functions up to sign.

target_invariant.name: Tropical Proof Rank
target_invariant.what_it_should_bound: The minimum number of phase transitions required to simulate a bounded arithmetic proof line in V⁰ or IΔ₀, thereby bounding the strength of definable functions and aiming to separate bounded arithmetic theories via circuit phase complexity.

axioms_tentative: A1: (Phase Stability Axiom) Any function provably total in IΔ₀ has a tropical circuit with polynomially many phase cells under uniform input scaling.
A2: (Weight-Proof Correspondence) The sum of absolute weights in a tropical circuit for a formula encoding a proof line is at least the bit-complexity of the cut-free proof in bounded arithmetic.
A3: (Tropical Soundness) If a bounded arithmetic theory proves a ∀Σ₁ᵇ sentence, then its tropical circuit model exhibits a homotopy-stable phase space under perturbation.
